scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run build:server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run smoke && npm run test:memory-core && npm run test:auth && npm run test:server && npm run test:dashboard
scripts.test: npm run test:memory-core && npm run test:auth && npm run test:server && npm run test:dashboard
scripts.test:server: npm run build --workspace @handoffbase/memory-core && npm run build:server && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @handoffbase/memory-core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run build:server -- --noEmit
scripts.dashboard:build: npm run build --workspace @handoffbase/memory-core && npm run build --workspace @handoffbase/dashboard
